rows.requirement: Supervision-first mobile IA with Home, Projects, Work, Agents and You; heavy Build authoring remains desktop-first
Same-origin manifest, controlled install lifecycle and scoped service worker
Only non-sensitive app-shell resources may be cached
Only allow-listed local S0/S1 drafts may persist offline
Queue payload, authority and replay receipts are SHA-256 bound
Origin reachability and current policy must be revalidated before idempotent local replay
Physical phone/tablet/offline/reconnect evidence requires distinct external attestation
Software evidence cannot satisfy missing physical-device evidence
